## ℹ️ Note on `e2e (windows)` CI check

If the `e2e (windows)` check fails on this PR, please note that **it is unrelated to the changes in this PR**.

### Evidence

- This PR is **docs-only**: it adds a single row to the Plugins table in `ecosystem.mdx` (+1 line, 0 code changes)
- The `e2e (windows)` failure is caused by a **known Bun issue** on Windows CI runners:

```
ENOENT: failed opening cache/package/version dir for package @opencode-ai/sdk
ENOENT: failed opening cache/package/version dir for package zod
```

- This happens in `bun install --no-cache` (used in `packages/opencode/src/bun/index.ts` and `config.ts:installDependencies()`)
- The root cause is tracked in **[oven-sh/bun#19936](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/issues/19936)** — Bun's `--no-cache` mode has intermittent `ENOENT` failures on Windows
- The OpenCode codebase itself already acknowledges this with a TODO comment: `// TODO: get rid of this case (see: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/issues/19936)`
- All other CI checks (unit tests, typecheck, standards, compliance, nix-eval, e2e linux) pass successfully

### Summary

| Check | Status | Relevant to this PR? |
|-------|--------|---------------------|
| unit (linux) | ✅ | N/A (docs only) |
| unit (windows) | ✅ | N/A (docs only) |
| e2e (linux) | ✅ | N/A (docs only) |
| e2e (windows) | ⚠️ flaky | ❌ No — known bun#19936 |
| typecheck | ✅ | N/A (docs only) |
| check-standards | ✅ | N/A (docs only) |
| check-compliance | ✅ | N/A (docs only) |

On our end, we need this fix since our team uses a LiteLLM proxy to route requests to Gemini, OpenAI, and other providers. Without it, the agent stops after every tool call, which makes it essentially unusable for agentic workflows.
